name: Adobe Substance 3D API
description: Substance 3D automation for Adobe Firefly Services (image.adobe.io): a Substance3DPort + adapter for scene render, composite, and relight over the adobe-firefly-core foundation. Async, compute-heavy — the longest-running Firefly jobs; webhook job_mode + high timeout recommended.

questions.prompt: Which Substance 3D operations will you use?

checklist: Confirm the Substance 3D API entitlement + scope on your Adobe Developer Console project (same IMS Server-to-Server auth as Firefly)
Verify the current host/endpoints/payloads against Adobe docs — configured via ADOBE_SUBSTANCE_3D_BASE_URL (defaults to the image.adobe.io host family; the client posts absolute URLs there)

Provide presigned input (scene/mesh/material) + output hrefs; composite also needs a background plate, relight a lighting environment (HDRI) — use core passthrough or install an adobe-firefly-storage-* addon

Long-running jobs: these are the heaviest Firefly renders. Prefer webhook job_mode and raise ADOBE_WEBHOOK_TIMEOUT_MS; if polling, raise ADOBE_JOB_POLL_INTERVAL_MS to reduce status-check volume during long renders
Default output format is ADOBE_SUBSTANCE_3D_FORMAT (set at install)
